name: xray
description: xray-spinners: glanceable cards under the spinner showing what Claude is doing, what is left on its plate, and how the task stands

narration.title: xray: narration line
narration.description: A one-sentence » line from a small model (Haiku) at task start and on the first failure, at most once a minute. Off = cards show measured state only, no extra model calls.

customCards.title: xray: custom task cards
customCards.description: When the work has a measured property no ready-made card shows (git bisect, a benchmark loop, a batch with k/N progress, a long rerun build), a small model (Haiku) lays out the task card from the widget kit, once per such turn. Off = the kept default layouts only, no extra model calls.
